chapters.title: Walk in the light
chapters.summary: John declares what he has seen and touched of the Word of life. God is light. If we walk in the light we have fellowship, and if we confess our sins He is faithful to forgive.

chapters.title: Do not love the world
chapters.summary: Jesus is our advocate. Whoever says he knows God keeps His commands and loves his brother. Do not love the world, for it is passing away.

chapters.title: Children of God
chapters.summary: See what love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God. Love not in word only, but in deed and truth.

chapters.title: God is love
chapters.summary: Test the spirits. Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God. God is love, and perfect love casts out fear. We love because He first loved us.

chapters.title: That you may know
chapters.summary: Faith overcomes the world. God has given us eternal life in His Son. These things are written so that you may know you have eternal life.
